svg.aria-label: src/tokens.ts: One source in four layers: primitive > semantic > component > service. tokens.css: CSS vars. tailwind.css: Tailwind map. tokens.json: Hex values. consumers: Studio, widgets and SDK apps read all three. themes: default (website + dashboard look) and contrast (AAA). modes: light, dark and system. Default: follow the OS
